column1: Be'lakor: which units and abilities in this roster can buff or support it?
column2:
• SELF: Dark Master supplies Shadow within 6 inches. Choose ONE Shadow Form per battle round: Shadow Lord gives RR1 to non-Torrent Hits (except snap shooting); Wreathed limits incoming shooting to attackers within 18 inches; Pall forces enemy tests/heals Be'lakor, not a simultaneous extra mode.
  • GOD LIMIT: no god keyword, so no GUO Toughness, LoC Strength or Skarbrand Attacks aura.
  • ARMY / OBJECTIVES: territory Shadow from objective control, or a Corrupt Realspace objective within 6 inches. Shadow gives +1 Battle-shock and successful-test D3 healing (Plaguebearers may return D3 models).
  • INDIRECT GUO SUPPORT: Nurgle's Rot lowers a selected enemy's Toughness by 1 (enemy within 12 inches at end of YOUR Movement phase, until start of YOUR NEXT Movement phase), improving this unit's Wound comparisons against it.
  • DRAUGHT OF TERROR (1CP): improve AP by 1 (AP -1 becomes -2), ONE selected unit; full Wound rerolls against Battle-shocked targets, in YOUR Shooting phase or EITHER PLAYER'S Fight phase. Be'lakor's Pall or Skullmaster's charge tests can help create such targets.
  • DAEMONIC INVULNERABILITY (1CP): re-roll invulnerable saves of 1 after targeting, for THEIR Shooting phase.
  • WARP SURGE (1CP): in YOUR Charge phase, unit in Shadow can charge after Advancing. Skarbrand already has this natively.
  • ARRIVAL / MOBILITY: Warp Rifts permits >6-inch Deep Strike if wholly in Shadow or wholly within 6 inches of a matching-god Greater Daemon; Denizens (1CP, YOUR Movement phase) supplies >6-inch arrival anywhere. Realm of Chaos (1CP, end of THEIR turn) picks up unengaged units: two in Shadow or one elsewhere; mandatory ingress in YOUR NEXT Movement phase.
  • CORRUPT REALSPACE (1CP): start of EITHER PLAYER'S Command phase, unit on a controlled objective can make it sticky and create the 6-inch Shadow area. It can be another friendly unit that corrupts the supporting objective.
  • CORE SUPPORT: Command Re-roll (1CP, EITHER PLAYER'S applicable phase) can re-roll one eligible roll; Insane Bravery (1CP, once per battle, YOUR Command phase Battle-shock step) makes a test successful and can trigger Manifestation in Shadow. Rapid Ingress (1CP, end of THEIR Movement phase, round 2+) brings this unit in from reserves; Heroic Intervention and Counteroffensive can change combat opportunities/order.
  • CORE CHARACTER SUPPORT: Epic Challenge (1CP, EITHER PLAYER'S Fight phase) gives a selected Character model's melee weapons Precision until end of that Fight phase. It does not grant Precision to the bodyguard models.
  • CORE MONSTER SUPPORT: Crushing Impact (1CP, YOUR Charge phase after charging) can inflict impact mortals; it also risks self-mortals.
  • HIT-REROLL LIMIT: snap shooting (including Fire Overwatch) does not allow Hit rerolls, so Shadow Lord cannot override that restriction.
  • CORE SHOOTING SUPPORT: Fire Overwatch (1CP, end of THEIR Movement phase) lets an unengaged unit snap shoot one visible eligible enemy within 24 inches; Torrent still auto-hits. Weapon range and eligibility still apply.

column1: No Prisoners in 11th: does wiping the bodyguard while its leader survives count as destroying a unit?
column2:
No. Core Rule 19.02: unit-destroyed triggers only happen when the last model that started the battle in the attached unit is destroyed.
Your Bloodcrushers wiped out with Skullmaster still alive: zero unit kills for No Prisoners. Destroy the whole attached unit: one unit kill, not separate bodyguard and leader kills. The rule also applies if the leader dies first and bodyguards survive. This differs from 10th-edition advice about leaders becoming separate units.
